articles.title: Ethereum block builders received the most in a $3.4 million vault hack, data shows
articles.snippet: An automated trading bot copied the attack on K3 Capital's sBOLD vault, taking more than half the funds and paying most of its proceeds to get its transactions processed first.

articles.title: Payward, the owner of crypto exchange Kraken, is buying its CEO’s venture capital business, Tribe
articles.snippet: Sethi, who was appointed co-CEO of Kraken in October 2024, is also the chairman of Tribe Capital.

articles.title: Bain Capital Crypto leads $110M Variational round at $1.5B valuation
articles.snippet: Variational raised $110 million at a $1.5 billion valuation to expand Omni’s derivatives markets and increase trading limits.

articles.title: Palmer Luckey Says He’s Building an Offshore Haven for Industry—And 'Illegal' Medicine
articles.snippet: The Oculus founder says his decade-old SLAB project aims to escape state restrictions on manufacturing and medical treatment.

articles.title: OpenAI's GPT 6.2 Astra Challenges Anthropic on Price, But Not Every Benchmark
articles.snippet: OpenAI's latest models promise better professional work for less money, as the company battles Anthropic and Google for AI supremacy and faces tougher questions about increasingly capable systems and safety.
